0022600033.text: The San Antonio Spurs (5-2, on a five-game winning streak and 2-0 on the road) visit the Sacramento Kings (1-6) in an Emirates NBA Cup West Group C game, with the Spurs 6th in the West and 1 game back in the Southwest, while Sacramento is 14th in the West and 4.5 games back in the Pacific. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain), and Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Daeqwon Plowden (illness), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated). The Spurs lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 130-103 win in San Antonio on October 27, and they won the 2025-26 series 3-0.
